levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Missed or misstated at least one of the four categories (payment, deposit, tenant responsibilities, notice-to-end).

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All four categories are correctly and specifically stated using details from the excerpt.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All four categories are correct and the learner notes a specific consequence tied to each one, such as a late fee, deposit forfeiture risk, or a notice violation.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Task 3 list places at least one obligation on the wrong party.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All listed obligations are correctly attributed to tenant or landlord.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The learner explains, for at least one item, why that obligation logically falls on that party.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection names a clause already covered in task 2 without new insight.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Reflection identifies a specific clause and gives a plausible reason it's easy to miss.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Reflection also explains a concrete consequence of missing that clause.

lookFors: All four categories in task 2 use specific figures and terms from the excerpt (dollar amounts, day counts), not vague paraphrase.
Tenant and landlord responsibilities are not mixed up in task 3.
No real lease, address, or landlord name is referenced.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
